title: AfriMed-QA: A Pan-African, Multi-Specialty, Medical Question-Answering Benchmark Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM accuracy on a US-centric medical benchmark (MedQA/USMLE) versus the Pan-African benchmark (AfriMed-QA) to identify training data distribution disparities, and conducting blind human evaluations to rate whether LLM responses reflect local African contexts and require local expertise.
Blind human evaluation where clinician raters explicitly evaluated and scored LLM-generated medical answers for 'Indication of demographic bias' on a 1 to 5 scale.
